'''Eric Hunter''' is a member of [[Team 5]]<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref> and [[Hayes Hunter]]'s brother. He finished 4th at the [[2024 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-09-world-championships-bochum-germany-19-22-september-2024/ 2024 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
